messages:
leah: Heads up — AP-SOUTHEAST-1 queue depth for redwood-vicuna-13b just jumped. Seeing sustained backlog since the GPU kernel update started.

leah: current graph shows queued: ~8200 requests, p99 queue wait ~22s, GPU util 94% across the pool.

raj: ack. Is this the planned kernel rollout?

leah: yes, started 20m ago. But there's also a traffic spike from a single customer (org: streamly) hitting a new batch job.

omar: can we route that org to a different region or lower-priority pool?

hannah_ops: streamly's job is latency-insensitive batch, should be safe to throttle or move to dedicated-burst.

infra-bot: Incident detected: queue_depth > 5000 in ap-southeast-1 for model redwood-vicuna-13b. Auto-admission not triggered.

sam: trying a quick admission control tweak — lowering per-key concurrent tokens for vicuna-13b from 12 -> 6 for AP-SOUTHEAST-1 preemption.

raj: +1. Also can we enable prefix KV cache warmup rollback? The new kernel seems to regress cache behavior.

leah: rolling back cache patch for vicuna variants on the region. Command I'm running: 
```
redwoodctl regions patch ap-southeast-1 --model redwood-vicuna-13b --config '{"kv_cache_enabled":false}'
```

hannah_ops: copying: I'll open a temporary rate-limit for streamly org — set at 50rps while we stabilize.

sam: putting a soft route to fallback model redwood-vicuna-7b-quant for non-latency-sensitive calls. Policy below: 
```
if request.headers["x-org"] == "streamly" and request.tags.contains("batch"):\n  route -> vicuna-7b-quant
```

omar: what's the expected impact on cost if we spill to us-west fallback?

leah: cost delta ~ +18% for that org if we keep them in US-West (egress + reserved GPU premium). But cheaper than SLO breaches.

infra-bot: Autoscale suggestion: +2 pslots on ap-southeast-1 vicuna-13b pool; available capacity check: false (no free spare GPUs).

raj: since autoscale can't add pslots, let's free capacity: evict low-priority background jobs and pause preemptible experiments.

hannah_ops: started pausing nightly-encoder-experiments (low prio). That should free ~1.5 pslots.

sam: I created a canary admission rule to start rejecting new long-context requests (>2048 tokens) for vicuna-13b in aps1. This will reduce KV churn.

leah: after the immediate changes: queued down from 8200 -> 4200 in 9m, p99 wait down to 12s. Still high but improving.

raj: suggested follow-ups: 1) revert kernel rollout in aps1 until perf tests green, 2) add per-org backpressure metrics to console, 3) add auto-fallback routing for large batch jobs.

sam: I'll open a follow-up ticket with steps and cost estimate for routing vs capacity add: https://tracker.redwood/internal/RED-4621

deploy-bot: Deploy rollback requested by @leah for rollout/aps1/kernel-v2.0 — status: in progress.

omar: FYI ops: please monitor any SRE alert flapping while rollback completes.

hannah_ops: monitoring. If queue doesn't drop under 1500 in next 20m, we'll enforce a stricter org-level admission policy.

leah: thanks all — good containment for now. Will post final postmortem if rollback is needed. :thumbsup:
